- `'` → `'`
- `"` → `"`

```python
def _escape_inner(s: str, /) ->str:
    result = s.replace("&", "&")
    result = result.replace(">", ">")
    result = result.replace("<", "<")
    result = result.replace("'", "'")
    result = result.replace('"', """)
    return result
```
